prompt: Two angles of a triangle measure $40°$ and $65°$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the third angle?
hint: The three angles of any triangle add to $180°$.

hints.text: The three angles of any triangle add to $180°$.

explanation: The interior angles of a triangle always sum to $180°$.

alternativeExplanations.title: The sum never changes
steps: It is $180°$ for every triangle — acute, right, obtuse, large or small.
This is the single most-used fact in SAT geometry, and it is not on the reference sheet.
Any question giving you two angles of a triangle is handing you the third for free.
